# Primus Companies

> Primus Companies is a commercial general contractor rooted in Cedar Rapids since 1973. The company provides preconstruction, general construction, construction management, and coordinated design-build delivery for commercial, healthcare, industrial, and other owner-led projects.

## Services

- [Preconstruction](https://primus-companies.com/services/preconstruction): Budgeting, feasibility, site evaluation, constructability review
- [General Construction](https://primus-companies.com/services/general-construction): Ground-up and renovation, fixed pricing, single point of contact
- [Design-Build](https://primus-companies.com/services/design-build): Builder-led coordination with an owner’s architect and design partners
- [Construction Management](https://primus-companies.com/services/construction-management): Owner's representation, third-party oversight
- [Development Advisory](https://primus-companies.com/services/development-advisory): Site selection, financing, investor structure, feasibility

## Projects

- [Portfolio](https://primus-companies.com/projects): Selected commercial construction work across healthcare, commercial, industrial, and residential settings

## Blog

- [Field Notes](https://primus-companies.com/blog): Commercial construction perspectives on planning, design, finance, risk, and growth
